falsification_conditions.condition: The asset price closes below the 200-day moving average (200DMA) by more than 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown below key support (200DMA) would contradict the pattern's implied bullish momentum and invalidate the 'HOLD' signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score rises above 75 within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Exceeding the 75 threshold would indicate extreme volatility or a reversal, directly contradicting the current 'HOLD' verdict and pattern similarity to a breakout scenario.

falsification_conditions.condition: A central bank intervenes with a policy rate cut of ≥100 basis points within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such an intervention would introduce a material external factor invalidating the pattern's self-contained logic and proving the 'UNKNOWN' verdict incorrect.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
